instruction: In the cell_search.xls spreadsheet, type the number 9999 into cell H6.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened LibreOffice Calc, correctly identified B6='Nereida', switched to Chrome, attempted Google search for 'Nereida' but hit SSL certificate errors (NET::ERR_CERT_COMMON_NAME_INVALID). Spent remaining turns trying alternative approaches (DuckDuckGo, file manager, new tabs) but never successfully completed the search.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Calc cells, read cell values, switch between applications, switch Chrome tabs, type in URL bar and search bars, open new tabs
metadata.failure_analysis: Failed due to SSL certificate errors on google.com in the VM environment. The model correctly formed the search URL with the right query ('Nereida') but the page returned a privacy error instead of search results.
metadata.task_rationale: Focuses on the LibreOffice Calc portion of the model's demonstrated capability. The model successfully navigated cells and read values in the spreadsheet. This task tests cell editing, which is a logical next step from the reading ability demonstrated.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to cell H6 in LibreOffice Calc and typing 9999. Postconfig saves the file (Ctrl+S and Enter to confirm .xls format). Custom getter reads cell H6 (row 5, col 7, 0-indexed) using xlrd. Custom metric compares the value against expected 9999.

llm_judge_reasons: Cell addressing is correct: H6 maps to row=5, col=7 (0-indexed)
Getter correctly downloads .xls file from VM and reads the target cell using xlrd
Metric correctly receives rules dict directly (expected.get('expected_value')) per get_rule behavior
Numeric comparison via float() handles both int and float cell values correctly, with string fallback
Postconfig properly saves the file (activate window, Ctrl+S, Enter to confirm .xls format) before getter reads it
Single instruction requirement (type 9999 into H6) is fully covered by the evaluator
